basic_profile.bio: I'm a budding consultant with a background in business management. Originally from Texas, I developed an interest in Latin American markets during my undergraduate studies. I'm passionate about cross-cultural exchanges and have recently been exploring opportunities in Mexico and Colombia. When I'm not working, you can find me diving into TV series like Yellowjackets or seeking legal advice for some personal projects in India. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, typically after 7 PM CST. Currently, I'm single and focused on growing my career.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in International Business, I have a foundational understanding of global markets, particularly in Latin America. My interest in consulting was sparked during an internship with a multinational firm, where I worked on projects related to market entry strategies. I've been actively learning through online courses and networking with professionals in the field.
